title: characteristic interface
semantics: Edges point to prerequisites; dependencies are conjunctive; one alternative route suffices. Reviewed source topology, not a kernel proof trace.
conventions: Carriers, hypotheses, quantifiers and constant scope are recorded per node and in the corresponding Lean declarations.

nodes.title: ḡ(u,r) of (3.12) for fields in the X-ball, the coefficient of (5.1), at the clamped time min(u,u₀) (gBarX)

edges.rationale: gBarX takes the proof hH of MemXBall u₀ x H as its argument: ḡ_n is formed for an element h_n of X

nodes.source_hypotheses: u₀ ≥ 0; x a real number (no sign premise); H a continuous real function of (u,r) on [0,∞) × [0,∞) with a proof hH of MemXBall u₀ x H ; u, r in [0,∞)
nodes.source_quantifiers: for each u₀ in [0,∞), for each real x, for each continuous H on [0,∞) × [0,∞) with a proof hH of MemXBall u₀ x H, for each u and r in [0,∞)
nodes.source_conclusion: gBarX(u,r) := ḡ(H(min(u,u₀),·))(r), the sealed ḡ = mean of g of (3.12) for the slice H.curry (min u u₀), with the slice-class proof MemXBall.isSlice of hH at min(u,u₀) ≤ u₀ : the coefficient ḡ(u,r) of the characteristic equation (5.1). For u > u₀ it repeats the slice at u₀ (formal clamp, no source content)

nodes.title: ḡ(u,r) ≤ 1 for X-ball fields, from ḡ ≤ g ≤ 1 (gBarX_le_one)

edges.rationale: gBarX(u,r) is ḡ(r) of the slice at min(u,u₀) with the proof hH.isSlice

nodes.source_hypotheses: u₀ ≥ 0; x a real number (no sign premise); H a continuous real function of (u,r) on [0,∞) × [0,∞) with a proof hH of MemXBall u₀ x H ; u, r in [0,∞)
nodes.source_quantifiers: for each u₀ in [0,∞), for each real x, for each continuous H on [0,∞) × [0,∞) with a proof hH of MemXBall u₀ x H, for each u and r in [0,∞)
nodes.source_conclusion: gBarX(u,r) ≤ 1: the outer inequality of "ḡ ≤ g ≤ 1 (see (3.11))", p. 346, for the slice at min(u,u₀)

nodes.title: ḡ(u,r) > 0 for X-ball fields (gBarX_pos)

edges.rationale: gBarX(u,r) is ḡ(r) of the slice at min(u,u₀) with the proof hH.isSlice

nodes.source_hypotheses: u₀ ≥ 0; x a real number (no sign premise); H a continuous real function of (u,r) on [0,∞) × [0,∞) with a proof hH of MemXBall u₀ x H ; u, r in [0,∞)
nodes.source_quantifiers: for each u₀ in [0,∞), for each real x, for each continuous H on [0,∞) × [0,∞) with a proof hH of MemXBall u₀ x H, for each u and r in [0,∞)
nodes.source_conclusion: 0 < gBarX(u,r). Reconstructed: the transcribed passages do not state ḡ > 0

nodes.title: ḡ(u,·) is Lipschitz in r with constant (π/6)x², uniformly in u (lipschitzWith_gBarX)

edges.rationale: the statement concerns the lift of gBarX(u,·)

nodes.source_hypotheses: u₀ ≥ 0; x a real number (no sign premise); H a continuous real function of (u,r) on [0,∞) × [0,∞) with a proof hH of MemXBall u₀ x H ; u in [0,∞)
nodes.source_quantifiers: for each u₀ in [0,∞), for each real x, for each continuous H on [0,∞) × [0,∞) with a proof hH of MemXBall u₀ x H, for each u in [0,∞)
nodes.source_conclusion: the real lift s ↦ gBarX(u, s⁺) is Lipschitz on ℝ with constant Real.toNNReal((π/6)x²) = (π/6)x²: abs(gBarX(u,s⁺) − gBarX(u,t⁺)) ≤ (π/6)x² abs(s − t) for all real s, t. Reconstructed: the bound "abs(ḡ_{n_i}(u′,χ_{n_i}(u′)) − ḡ_{n_i}(u′,χ(u′))) ≤ a y_{n_i}(u′)" of p. 350 from "the equiboundedness of ∂ḡ_{n_i}/∂r", with a = (π/6)x²
nodes.constant_scope: the Lipschitz constant (π/6)x² depends only on the radius x, not on u, u₀ or H

nodes.title: Integral form of (5.1) from the terminal point, r(u) = r₁ + ½∫_u^{u₁} ḡ(u′, r(u′)) du′ (IsCharacteristic.eq_add_integral)

edges.rationale: the terminal value χ(u₁) = r₁ (first conjunct of hχ)
the derivative charField(s, χ(s)) unfolds to −½·gBarX(s⁺, χ(s)⁺)
F = χ is continuous on [t,u₁] ⊆ [0,u₁]
at every s in (t,u₁) ⊆ (0,u₁), χ has the two-sided derivative charField(s, χ(s))
the derivative s ↦ −½·gBarX(s⁺, χ(s)⁺) is integrable on [t,u₁]
on [t,u₁]: ∫_t^{u₁} χ′ = χ(u₁) − χ(t) = r₁ − χ(t)
∫_t^{u₁} −½·gBarX(s⁺, χ(s)⁺) ds = −½∫_t^{u₁} gBarX(s⁺, χ(s)⁺) ds; rearranging gives the display
the statement's integrand is gBarX(s⁺, χ(s)⁺), the coefficient ḡ(u′, r(u′)) of the display at the toNNReal arguments

nodes.source_hypotheses: u₀ ≥ 0; x a real number (no sign premise); H a continuous real function of (u,r) on [0,∞) × [0,∞) with a proof hH of MemXBall u₀ x H ; u₁ in [0,u₀] (u₁ : Icc 0 u₀, ); r₁ in [0,∞) (r₁ : ℝ≥0, ); χ a real function of real time with IsCharacteristic hH u₁ r₁ χ; t in [0,u₁]
nodes.source_quantifiers: for each u₀ in [0,∞), for each real x, for each continuous H on [0,∞) × [0,∞) with a proof hH of MemXBall u₀ x H, for each u₁ in [0,u₀], for each r₁ in [0,∞), for each real function χ with IsCharacteristic hH u₁ r₁ χ, for each t in [0,u₁]
nodes.source_conclusion: χ(t) = r₁ + ½∫_t^{u₁} gBarX(s⁺, χ(s)⁺) ds: the equality part of the p. 354 display r(u) = r₁ + ½∫_u^{u₁} ḡ_n(u′, r(u′)) du′ for the field H in place of h_n, with the coefficient gBarX of the slice at time s at the toNNReal arguments . The inequality ≥ r₁ + ½k(u₁ − u) of the same display is not part of it

nodes.title: The characteristic field −½ḡ of (5.1) as a total function of real time and radius (charField)

edges.rationale: charField takes the proof hH of MemXBall u₀ x H as its argument and passes it to gBarX
the body is −½ times gBarX at the clamped arguments t⁺, z⁺, the right side −½ḡ(u,r) of (5.1)

nodes.source_hypotheses: u₀ ≥ 0; x a real number (no sign premise); H a continuous real function of (u,r) on [0,∞) × [0,∞) with a proof hH of MemXBall u₀ x H ; t, z real
nodes.source_quantifiers: for each u₀ in [0,∞), for each real x, for each continuous H on [0,∞) × [0,∞) with a proof hH of MemXBall u₀ x H, for each real t and each real z
nodes.source_conclusion: charField(t,z) := −½·gBarX(t⁺, z⁺), with t⁺ = max(t,0) and z⁺ = max(z,0) (Real.toNNReal): the right side −½ḡ(u,r) of dr/du = −½ḡ(u,r), (5.1), as a total field on ℝ × ℝ ; the time is further clamped to [0,u₀] inside gBarX. On the physical strip 0 ≤ t ≤ u₀, z ≥ 0 it is −½ḡ(t,z) (root n0006.of_le)

nodes.title: Backward characteristic of (5.1) through the terminal point (u₁, r₁) on [0, u₁] (IsCharacteristic)

edges.rationale: IsCharacteristic takes the proof hH of MemXBall u₀ x H as its argument and passes it to charField
the derivative required at time t is charField(t, χ(t)), the right side −½ḡ(u,r) of (5.1) as a total field

nodes.source_hypotheses: u₀ ≥ 0; x a real number (no sign premise); H a continuous real function of (u,r) on [0,∞) × [0,∞) with a proof hH of MemXBall u₀ x H ; u₁ in [0,u₀] (u₁ : Icc 0 u₀, ); r₁ in [0,∞) (r₁ : ℝ≥0, ); χ a real function of real time
nodes.source_quantifiers: for each u₀ in [0,∞), for each real x, for each continuous H on [0,∞) × [0,∞) with a proof hH of MemXBall u₀ x H, for each u₁ in [0,u₀], for each r₁ in [0,∞), for each real function χ
nodes.source_conclusion: IsCharacteristic hH u₁ r₁ χ holds iff χ(u₁) = r₁ and, for every t in [0,u₁], χ has the derivative charField(t, χ(t)) at t within [0,u₁] (one-sided at both endpoints, ): χ is a characteristic of (5.1) dr/du = −½ḡ(u,r) through the terminal point (u₁, r₁) of the physical strip, on the time interval [0,u₁] (the backward characteristic of pp. 349-350 and 354-355, ), with the clamped coefficient charField = −½ḡ . Nothing is asserted outside [0,u₁]; for u₁ = 0 only χ(0) = r₁ is constrained (a within-derivative on a singleton is unconstrained, ). Forward characteristics χ(u; r₀) from u = 0 are not defined

nodes.title: A characteristic is continuous on [0, u₁]

edges.rationale: the second conjunct gives a derivative of χ within [0,u₁] at every point of [0,u₁]
a function with a within-[0,u₁] derivative at every point of [0,u₁] is continuous on [0,u₁]

nodes.source_hypotheses: u₀ ≥ 0; x a real number (no sign premise); H a continuous real function of (u,r) on [0,∞) × [0,∞) with a proof hH of MemXBall u₀ x H ; u₁ in [0,u₀] (u₁ : Icc 0 u₀, ); r₁ in [0,∞) (r₁ : ℝ≥0, ); χ a real function of real time with IsCharacteristic hH u₁ r₁ χ
nodes.source_quantifiers: for each u₀ in [0,∞), for each real x, for each continuous H on [0,∞) × [0,∞) with a proof hH of MemXBall u₀ x H, for each u₁ in [0,u₀], for each r₁ in [0,∞), for each real function χ with IsCharacteristic hH u₁ r₁ χ
nodes.source_conclusion: χ is continuous on [0,u₁]

nodes.title: The coefficient along a characteristic, s ↦ ḡ(s⁺, χ(s)⁺), is continuous on [0, u₁], hence integrable there

edges.rationale: the integrand ḡ(u′, r(u′)) is gBarX at the clamped arguments (s⁺, χ(s)⁺)
(u,r) ↦ gBarX(u,r) is jointly continuous on [0,∞)²
χ is continuous on [0,u₁]
s ↦ s⁺ is continuous, so s ↦ (s⁺, χ(s)⁺) is continuous on [0,u₁] and its composition with gBarX is continuous on [0,u₁]
a function continuous on [a,b] ⊆ [0,u₁] is integrable on [a,b] (measurability included)

nodes.source_hypotheses: u₀ ≥ 0; x a real number (no sign premise); H a continuous real function of (u,r) on [0,∞) × [0,∞) with a proof hH of MemXBall u₀ x H ; u₁ in [0,u₀] (u₁ : Icc 0 u₀, ); r₁ in [0,∞) (r₁ : ℝ≥0, ); χ a real function of real time with IsCharacteristic hH u₁ r₁ χ
nodes.source_quantifiers: for each u₀ in [0,∞), for each real x, for each continuous H on [0,∞) × [0,∞) with a proof hH of MemXBall u₀ x H, for each u₁ in [0,u₀], for each r₁ in [0,∞), for each real function χ with IsCharacteristic hH u₁ r₁ χ
nodes.source_conclusion: s ↦ gBarX(s⁺, χ(s)⁺) is continuous on [0,u₁]; hence it, and every constant multiple of it (in particular the derivative s ↦ charField(s, χ(s)) = −½·gBarX(s⁺, χ(s)⁺)), is (measurable and) integrable on every interval [a,b] ⊆ [0,u₁]: the integrands of the p. 354 display and of (5.2) are honest integrals, not default values

nodes.title: At interior times a characteristic has the two-sided derivative charField(t, χ(t))

edges.rationale: the second conjunct at t in (0,u₁) ⊆ [0,u₁] gives the derivative within [0,u₁]
[0,u₁] is a neighbourhood of every t in (0,u₁), so the within-[0,u₁] derivative is a two-sided derivative

nodes.source_hypotheses: u₀ ≥ 0; x a real number (no sign premise); H a continuous real function of (u,r) on [0,∞) × [0,∞) with a proof hH of MemXBall u₀ x H ; u₁ in [0,u₀] (u₁ : Icc 0 u₀, ); r₁ in [0,∞) (r₁ : ℝ≥0, ); χ a real function of real time with IsCharacteristic hH u₁ r₁ χ; t in (0,u₁)
nodes.source_quantifiers: for each u₀ in [0,∞), for each real x, for each continuous H on [0,∞) × [0,∞) with a proof hH of MemXBall u₀ x H, for each u₁ in [0,u₀], for each r₁ in [0,∞), for each real function χ with IsCharacteristic hH u₁ r₁ χ, for each t in (0,u₁)
nodes.source_conclusion: χ has the (two-sided) derivative charField(t, χ(t)) at t (HasDerivAt)

nodes.title: Speed bounds −½ ≤ charField(t, z) < 0 for all real t, z

edges.rationale: charField(t,z) unfolds to −½·gBarX(t⁺, z⁺)
applied at (t⁺, z⁺): 0 < gBarX(t⁺, z⁺), so charField(t,z) < 0
applied at (t⁺, z⁺): gBarX(t⁺, z⁺) ≤ 1 (the clause ḡ ≤ g ≤ 1), so charField(t,z) ≥ −½

nodes.source_hypotheses: u₀ ≥ 0; x a real number (no sign premise); H a continuous real function of (u,r) on [0,∞) × [0,∞) with a proof hH of MemXBall u₀ x H ; t, z real
nodes.source_quantifiers: for each u₀ in [0,∞), for each real x, for each continuous H on [0,∞) × [0,∞) with a proof hH of MemXBall u₀ x H, for each real t and each real z
nodes.source_conclusion: −½ ≤ charField(t,z) < 0, i.e. −½ ≤ −½ḡ < 0 at the clamped arguments (t⁺, z⁺): incoming light rays move inward with speed at most ½

nodes.title: Uniqueness: two characteristics through the same terminal point agree on [0, u₁] (IsCharacteristic.eqOn)

edges.rationale: both premises; their first conjuncts give the common terminal value χ(u₁) = r₁ = ψ(u₁)
applied on [a,b] = [0,u₁] with v = charField, spatial sets s t = univ and the terminal equality at b = u₁
the Lipschitz premise for t in (0,u₁], with K = toNNReal((π/12)x²) on univ
applied to χ and to ψ: the derivative premises within Iic t for t in (0,u₁]
applied to χ and to ψ: the continuity premises on [0,u₁]

nodes.source_hypotheses: u₀ ≥ 0; x a real number (no sign premise); H a continuous real function of (u,r) on [0,∞) × [0,∞) with a proof hH of MemXBall u₀ x H ; u₁ in [0,u₀] (u₁ : Icc 0 u₀, ); r₁ in [0,∞) (r₁ : ℝ≥0, ); χ, ψ real functions of real time with IsCharacteristic hH u₁ r₁ χ and IsCharacteristic hH u₁ r₁ ψ
nodes.source_quantifiers: for each u₀ in [0,∞), for each real x, for each continuous H on [0,∞) × [0,∞) with a proof hH of MemXBall u₀ x H, for each u₁ in [0,u₀], for each r₁ in [0,∞), for all real functions χ and ψ that are characteristics through (u₁, r₁)
nodes.source_conclusion: χ = ψ on [0,u₁] (EqOn χ ψ (Icc 0 u₁)). Reconstructed: [P] speaks of "the characteristics χ(u;r₁) through r = r₁ at u = u₁" determined by the ODE and the terminal condition, presupposing uniqueness without proof

nodes.title: A characteristic has the left derivative charField(t, χ(t)) within (−∞, t] at every t in (0, u₁]

edges.rationale: the second conjunct at t in (0,u₁] ⊆ [0,u₁] gives the derivative within [0,u₁]
for t in (0,u₁], [0,u₁] is a neighbourhood of t within (−∞,t] (Icc_mem_nhdsLE_of_mem), so the derivative transfers to Iic t

nodes.source_hypotheses: u₀ ≥ 0; x a real number (no sign premise); H a continuous real function of (u,r) on [0,∞) × [0,∞) with a proof hH of MemXBall u₀ x H ; u₁ in [0,u₀] (u₁ : Icc 0 u₀, ); r₁ in [0,∞) (r₁ : ℝ≥0, ); χ a real function of real time with IsCharacteristic hH u₁ r₁ χ; t in (0,u₁]
nodes.source_quantifiers: for each u₀ in [0,∞), for each real x, for each continuous H on [0,∞) × [0,∞) with a proof hH of MemXBall u₀ x H, for each u₁ in [0,u₀], for each r₁ in [0,∞), for each real function χ with IsCharacteristic hH u₁ r₁ χ, for each t in (0,u₁]
nodes.source_conclusion: χ has the derivative charField(t, χ(t)) at t within Iic t = (−∞, t]

nodes.title: Global Lipschitz bound: charField(t, ·) is (π/12)x²-Lipschitz on ℝ for every real t

edges.rationale: charField(t,z) − charField(t,z′) = −½·(gBarX(t⁺, z⁺) − gBarX(t⁺, z′⁺))
applied at u = t⁺: abs(gBarX(t⁺, z⁺) − gBarX(t⁺, z′⁺)) ≤ (π/6)x² abs(z − z′); multiplying by ½ gives the constant (π/12)x², and toNNReal(π/6·x²)/2 = toNNReal(π/12·x²)

nodes.source_hypotheses: u₀ ≥ 0; x a real number (no sign premise); H a continuous real function of (u,r) on [0,∞) × [0,∞) with a proof hH of MemXBall u₀ x H ; t real
nodes.source_quantifiers: for each u₀ in [0,∞), for each real x, for each continuous H on [0,∞) × [0,∞) with a proof hH of MemXBall u₀ x H, for each real t
nodes.source_conclusion: z ↦ charField(t,z) is Lipschitz on ℝ with constant K = Real.toNNReal((π/12)x²): abs(charField(t,z) − charField(t,z′)) ≤ (π/12)x² abs(z − z′) for all real z, z′
nodes.constant_scope: K = toNNReal((π/12)x²) depends only on the ball radius x, not on t, u₀ or H; it is the K of the sealed capstone

nodes.title: Existence of the characteristic through every terminal point of the physical strip (exists_isCharacteristic)

edges.rationale: the conclusion is ∃ χ, IsCharacteristic hH u₁ r₁ χ
the sealed capstone applied with t₀ = u₁ (an element of [0,u₀]), z₀ = r₁ and initial-ball radius ρ = 0: IsPicardLindelof charField u₁ r₁ (0 + u₀/2) 0 (1/2) K on [0,u₀]
applied to that structure: a total α with α(u₁) = r₁ and α′(t) = charField(t, α(t)) within [0,u₀] at every t in [0,u₀]
applied to α: restricting the derivative set to [0,u₁] gives IsCharacteristic hH u₁ r₁ α, the witness

nodes.source_hypotheses: u₀ ≥ 0; x a real number (no sign premise); H a continuous real function of (u,r) on [0,∞) × [0,∞) with a proof hH of MemXBall u₀ x H ; u₁ in [0,u₀] (u₁ : Icc 0 u₀, ); r₁ in [0,∞) (r₁ : ℝ≥0, )
nodes.source_quantifiers: for each u₀ in [0,∞), for each real x, for each continuous H on [0,∞) × [0,∞) with a proof hH of MemXBall u₀ x H, for each u₁ in [0,u₀], for each r₁ in [0,∞)
nodes.source_conclusion: there exists a real function χ with IsCharacteristic hH u₁ r₁ χ. Reconstructed: [P] asserts that the characteristics through r = r₁ at u = u₁ satisfy dχ/du = −½ḡ with χ(u₁;r₁) = r₁ (p. 349), but does not argue their existence
nodes.constant_scope: none (the witness χ may depend on u₀, x, H, hH, u₁ and r₁; its values outside [0,u₁] are not determined, )

nodes.title: A Picard–Lindelöf solution on [0, u₀] through (u₁, r₁) is a characteristic on [0, u₁]

edges.rationale: the conclusion is the predicate: the terminal value α(u₁) = r₁ is the first conjunct verbatim
for t in [0,u₁] ⊆ [0,u₀] the derivative within [0,u₀] restricts to a derivative within the subset [0,u₁], the second conjunct

nodes.source_hypotheses: u₀ ≥ 0; x a real number (no sign premise); H a continuous real function of (u,r) on [0,∞) × [0,∞) with a proof hH of MemXBall u₀ x H ; u₁ in [0,u₀] (u₁ : Icc 0 u₀, ); r₁ in [0,∞) (r₁ : ℝ≥0, ); α a real function of real time with α(u₁) = r₁ and, for every t in [0,u₀], α has the derivative charField(t, α(t)) at t within [0,u₀]
nodes.source_quantifiers: for each u₀ in [0,∞), for each real x, for each continuous H on [0,∞) × [0,∞) with a proof hH of MemXBall u₀ x H, for each u₁ in [0,u₀], for each r₁ in [0,∞), for each real function α with these two properties
nodes.source_conclusion: IsCharacteristic hH u₁ r₁ α

nodes.title: Exactly one curve on [0, u₁] whose constant extension is a characteristic through (u₁, r₁) (existsUnique_characteristicOn)

edges.rationale: the property in the ∃! is IsCharacteristic hH u₁ r₁ of the extension
the property is stated through curveExtension u₁ χ
existence part: a characteristic χ through (u₁, r₁) on real time
applied to that χ: its restriction to [0,u₁] is a witness
uniqueness part: the extensions of two witnesses are characteristics through (u₁, r₁), hence agree on [0,u₁]
the two witnesses are therefore equal on the subtype

nodes.source_hypotheses: u₀ ≥ 0; x a real number (no sign premise); H a continuous real function of (u,r) on [0,∞) × [0,∞) with a proof hH of MemXBall u₀ x H ; u₁ in [0,u₀] (u₁ : Icc 0 u₀, ); r₁ in [0,∞) (r₁ : ℝ≥0, )
nodes.source_quantifiers: for each u₀ in [0,∞), for each real x, for each continuous H on [0,∞) × [0,∞) with a proof hH of MemXBall u₀ x H, for each u₁ in [0,u₀], for each r₁ in [0,∞)
nodes.source_conclusion: there is exactly one real function χ on the time subtype [0,u₁] such that curveExtension u₁ χ is a characteristic through (u₁, r₁) (∃!, ). Reconstructed: the well-definedness of "the characteristic χ(u;r₁) through r = r₁ at u = u₁", used as a function on pp. 349-350 and along which (7.20) is integrated

nodes.title: The constant extension of the restriction of a characteristic to [0, u₁] is again a characteristic

edges.rationale: curveExtension u₁ χ̂ (s) = χ(projIcc 0 u₁ s)
both conjuncts of hχ are transferred: the terminal value at u₁ and the derivatives within [0,u₁]
for s in [0,u₁], projIcc 0 u₁ s = s, so the extension equals χ on [0,u₁] (in particular at u₁)
a derivative within [0,u₁] at a point of [0,u₁] depends only on the values on [0,u₁], and the value charField(t, χ(t)) is unchanged

nodes.source_hypotheses: u₀ ≥ 0; x a real number (no sign premise); H a continuous real function of (u,r) on [0,∞) × [0,∞) with a proof hH of MemXBall u₀ x H ; u₁ in [0,u₀] (u₁ : Icc 0 u₀, ); r₁ in [0,∞) (r₁ : ℝ≥0, ); χ a real function of real time with IsCharacteristic hH u₁ r₁ χ
nodes.source_quantifiers: for each u₀ in [0,∞), for each real x, for each continuous H on [0,∞) × [0,∞) with a proof hH of MemXBall u₀ x H, for each u₁ in [0,u₀], for each r₁ in [0,∞), for each real function χ with IsCharacteristic hH u₁ r₁ χ
nodes.source_conclusion: IsCharacteristic hH u₁ r₁ (curveExtension u₁ χ̂), where χ̂ is the restriction of χ to the time subtype [0,u₁]: the extension agrees with χ on [0,u₁], and the predicate reads only values on [0,u₁]

nodes.title: Closed ball of radius x in the space X of (7.1) on the strip [0,u₀]×[0,∞) (MemXBall)
nodes.source_hypotheses: u₀ ≥ 0; x a real number (no sign premise); H is a continuous real function of (u,r) on the quadrant [0,∞) × [0,∞) (field carrier , reused), with slices H(u,·); values of H for u > u₀ are unconstrained
nodes.source_quantifiers: for each u₀ in [0,∞), for each real x, for each continuous H on [0,∞) × [0,∞)
nodes.source_conclusion: MemXBall u₀ x H holds iff (1) for every u in [0,∞) with u ≤ u₀ the slice lift s ↦ H(u, s⁺) is C¹ (ContDiffOn of order 1) on [0,∞), with the derivative at s = 0 one-sided within [0,∞) ; (2) the map (u,r) ↦ ∂_r H(u,r), the derivative within [0,∞) at r of the lift s ↦ H(u⁺, s⁺), is continuous on the closed strip [0,u₀] × [0,∞); (3) for every u ≤ u₀ and every r ≥ 0, (1+r)³ abs(H(u,r)) + (1+r)⁴ abs(∂_r H(u,r)) ≤ x. Fields (1)-(2) are "continuous and posess a continuous partial derivative with respect to r" of (7.1) (continuity of H itself is the carrier's); field (3) is ‖H‖_X ≤ x for the printed sum norm (7.1) (U-NORMS), i.e. membership in "the closed ball of radius x₁ in the space X" of Lemma 1 with x₁ = x . No evolution equation and no ∂_u H are assumed
nodes.constant_scope: the radius x is an explicit parameter of the predicate, not existential ; the double sup over u then r of (7.1) is replaced by the equivalent pointwise bound for all u ≤ u₀ and all r ≥ 0

coverage.reason: dr/du = −½ḡ(u,r) along the incoming light rays: IsCharacteristic is (5.1) with the clamped coefficient charField on [0,u₁] through a terminal point ; the regularity of a solution (continuity, interior two-sided derivative) and its inward motion (antitone, strictly decreasing) are reconstructed consequences of (5.1). The coefficient ḡ is the imported gBarX through charField.

χ(u;r₀) and (5.2): stated along the backward characteristic with r₀ := χ(0) as the root eq_sub_integral ; the forward parametrization χ(u;r₀) itself is deferred . The integral needs the continuity of the integrand along the curve (step) and the joint continuity of ḡ (imported).
